name: Kaocid
description: TB-303 style acid bass with auto phrase generator for NTS-3. Hold pad to play a tempo-synced 16-step pattern. Touch again to regenerate a new rhythm, scale, accent, and slide style. X = Cutoff, Y = Resonance, Depth = mix. Voice inspired by Andy Sloane gsynth TB-303 (2001 abandonware).

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Filter envelope decay on non-accent notes (~200 ms to 2.5 s; accents fixed at ~200 ms)

params.name: ACC
params.detail: Accent amount: louder VCA + resonance Accent Sweep (wapp)
